name: Enrich Property Inventory Survey with Image Recognition and AI Agent
description: Enhances property inventory surveys with image recognition and AI agents for automated data enrichment.

content.text:
Focus on the {{last.result.Title}} in the image - we'll refer to this as the "object". Identify the following attributes of the object. If you cannot determine confidently, then leave blank and move to next attribute.
* Decription of the object.
* The model/make of the object.
* The material(s) used in the construction of the object.
* The color(s) of the object
* The condition of the object. Use one of poor, good, excellent.

setup: "Execute Workflow Trigger" (executeWorkflowTrigger) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
Setup value airtableBaseId: Airtable base id (for example appXXXX (from the base URL)). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value airtableTableId: Airtable table id (for example tblXXXX (from the table URL)). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Workflow secret SERPAPI_KEY: SerpApi key for serpapi.com (query parameter api_key=<secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.
Workflow secret FIRECRAWL_API_KEY: Firecrawl API key for api.firecrawl.dev (Authorization: Bearer <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.

hints: The original was a sub-workflow called by another workflow; pass its inputs as run inputs.
"Analyse Image" (image.analyze): Vision call through OpenAI Responses with the image URL as an input_image item.

"Object Identifier Agent" used agent tools in the original: Firecrawl Web Scaper Tool (toolWorkflow), Reverse Image Search Tool (toolWorkflow). The cdecli agent calls connectors directly; connect credentials for the services those tools reached.
"SERP Google Reverse Image API" authenticated with serpApi in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"Firecrawl Scrape API" authenticated with httpHeaderAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect airtable: `cdecli credential create -n "airtable" -p airtable --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect openai: `cdecli credential create -n "openai" -p openai --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## 1. Use Airtable to Capture Survey Photos
[Read more about AirTable](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/app-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.airtable)

To enable this workflow, we need a database where we can retreive the title and photo to analyse and write the generate values back to. Airtable is perfect for this since it has a robust API we can work with.

For this demo, we'll manually trigger but this can be changed for forms or other triggers.

## 2. Use AI Vision Model to Analyse the Photo.
[Read more about OpenAI Vision](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/app-nodes/n8n-nodes-langchain.openai)

We'll use OpenAi vision model to create a detailed description of the product in the photo. We split this step from the agent because it uses an image model rather than the usual text-based one.

## 3. Build an AI Agent who Searches the Internet
[Read more about OpenAI Agents](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/app-nodes/n8n-nodes-langchain.openai)

This AI Agent has the ability to perform reverse image searches using our captured photos as well visit external webpages in order to obtain accurate product names and attributes. The Agent along with the tools might mimic what the average human user would carry out the same task.

* For reverse image search, we're using SERP API service however we won't use the built-in SERP node as we need to specify custom parameters. 
* For scraping, we'll use [Firecrawl](https://www.firecrawl.dev/) as this service also helps to parse and return the page as markdown which is more efficient.

## 4. Overwrite our Rows with Enriched Results

And Viola! Our AI agent has potentially saved hours of manual data entry work for our surveyor. This technique can be used for many other usecases.

## 5. Using the Custom Workflow Tool
[Read more about Workflow Tools](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/cluster-nodes/sub-nodes/n8n-nodes-langchain.toolworkflow)

AI Agents rely on Tools to make decisions and become exponentially more powerful the more tools they have. A common pattern to manage multiple tools is to create a routing system for tools using the API pattern.

## Try It Out!
### This workflow does the following:
* Scans an Airtable spreadsheet for rows with product photo images.
* Uses an AI vision model to attempt to identify the product.
* Uses an AI Agent to research the product on the internet to enrich the product data.
* Overwrites our Airtable spreadsheet with the enriched data.
